Grade: PP1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Patterns CLASSIFICATION

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Patterns CLASSIFICATION, part of Strand 1 in PP1 MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: which pattern make a pattern?
